title: 30-second studio showreel in Remotion
prompt_text: Make a short video analyze my studio, no voice-over, just music, boiled down to a general description of a studio that makes apps born from everyday-life ideas. Don't name the apps, only the studio's name. Style: bold geometric animations, stunning fluid visuals, futuristic animated dashboards, smooth cinematic transitions, a Claude-inspired motion design reel.Build a 30-second motion design showreel as code (Remotion + React, TypeScript), rendered to MP4 at 1920×1080, 60fps, with a music track synced at 128 BPM. Theme: "ARCTIC HARE STUDIO", a showreel for the studio. Every scene must feel hand-animated: real easing, squash & stretch, overshoot, motion blur on fast moves — no linear tweens. Make the dynamic 30-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. Go all out.

title: 2D documentary-cartoon animation style
prompt_text: Stylized 2D animation still frame in the style of a modern documentary cartoon, clean flat colors with soft cel shading, expressive character design, cinematic framing.
